list.intro: What you sold, day by day. Enter today's sales in one go, or one sale for a job or a customer.
list.introViewer: What was sold, day by day.
list.booksClosed: The books are closed up to {{date}}: sales on or before that day can't be finalized or reversed.
list.takenBack: Sales of a closed day, reversed on this day, are taken off here.

empty.title: No sales yet
empty.body: Enter what you sold today with − and +, or one sale for a job or a single customer. Your sales and their profit show here.
empty.viewer: Sales show here once your team enters them.

filters.noMatchesHint: Try other filters, or clear them.

sheet.title: Today's sales
sheet.daysHint: Days within one month. They are saved as one sale on the last day.
sheet.productsHint: Tap + for each one sold, or type how many. The price is filled in: change it here for this day only.
sheet.noProducts: There is nothing to sell here yet. Add your products and services first.
sheet.gone: No longer sold here: kept on this sheet.
sheet.saved: Saved. You can finish it later.
sheet.nothing: Nothing is sold on this sheet yet: tap + on what you sold.
sheet.conflict: This sheet was changed somewhere else at the same time. Here is the latest version.
sheet.closed: The books are closed up to {{date}}: you can save these sales, but not finalize them.
sheet.closedFinalize: The books are closed up to {{date}}, so these sales can't be finalized. Pick a later day, or open the books in Settings.
sheet.notYourBranch: You don't work in this branch. Pick one of your branches.
sheet.noChannelBody: Every channel is archived. Bring one back in Settings → Sales channels.
sheet.finalMore: More sales of this day? Enter them as one sale.
sheet.finalHint: A final sheet changes only by a correction.
sheet.imported: A file imported for {{channel}} already has sales of these days. Enter here only what the file does not have, or the same sales count twice.

editor.intro: For a job or a single customer. A draft changes nothing; once finalized, it counts in your sales.
editor.addOption: Add “{{name}}” as a new product or service
editor.addOption_projects: Add “{{name}}” as a new service or work item
editor.noProductAccess: Your role doesn't include products and services, so you can't pick them here. Ask the owner if you need it.
editor.noProductsYet: Your list is empty. Type what you sold on the line and add it as new.
editor.noProductsAsk: There is nothing to sell yet. Ask the owner to add your products and services.
editor.deliveryChargedHint: Leave it empty when delivery was free for them.
editor.deliveryCostHint: What you paid the driver or the courier. You can add it later.
editor.notesHint: Anything worth remembering about this sale (optional)
editor.conflict: Someone else changed this at the same time. Open it again to see the latest version.
editor.copiedFrom: This draft corrects a sale that was reversed. Fix it, then finalize it.
editor.closedEarlier: The books are closed up to {{date}}. To finalize, pick a later date.
editor.closedToday: The books are closed up to today ({{date}}). You can save a draft and finalize it tomorrow, or open the books in Settings.
editor.savedNotFinalized: Saved as a draft, not finalized: {{reason}}

errors.date: Pick the date of the sale.
errors.itemGone: This product is no longer in your list. Pick another one.
errors.discountOverLine: The discount is more than the line.
errors.noItem: Add what was sold before you finalize.

view.title: Sale of {{date}}
view.periodNote: Several days typed at once count as one sale on {{date}}.
view.noRecipeHint: Profit not complete yet: add the materials it uses.
view.noRecipeHint_food: Profit not complete yet: write its recipe.
view.noRecipeHint_retail: Profit not complete yet: add the items it uses.
view.unpriced: Never bought, so no price yet: {{names}}. It is filled once you buy it.
view.timeNoRate: Your time: your hourly rate isn't set yet.
view.profit: Profit before running costs and fees:
view.profitNote: Running costs and app fees come off once real profit is worked out.
view.timeTotalNoRate: your hourly rate isn't set yet
view.costsHidden: Costs and profit are hidden: your role doesn't show costs.
view.reversedNote: Reversed on {{date}}: it no longer counts in your sales.
view.draftNote: A draft: it doesn't count in your sales yet.
view.notFoundBody: It may have been discarded, or it isn't one you can see.
view.importedNote: These sales came from a file. To take them back, reverse this day (or the whole file) from its import.

confirm.finalizeBody: It counts as {{amount}} of your sales on {{date}}, and what it used is costed as of that day.
confirm.finalizeNote: A final sale can't be edited. If something is wrong later, you can reverse it or correct it.
confirm.finalizeSheetBody: They count as {{amount}} of your sales on {{date}}, and what they used is costed as of that day.
confirm.finalizePeriodBody: They count as {{amount}} of your sales, as one sale on {{date}} (covers {{from}} – {{to}}), and what they used is costed as of that day.
confirm.finalizeSheetNote: Final sales can't be edited. If something is wrong later, they can be reversed or corrected.
confirm.finalizeClosedToday: The books are closed up to today, so nothing can be finalized today. You can finalize it from tomorrow, or once the books are open again in Settings.
confirm.reverseBody: It will be as if it was never finalized: it no longer counts in your sales of {{date}}.
confirm.reverseNote: It stays in your list, marked reversed.
confirm.reverseDated: The books are closed for its day, so the reversal counts on {{date}}, the first open day.
confirm.reverseClosed: The books are closed up to today, so nothing can be reversed today. You can reverse it from tomorrow, or once the books are open again in Settings.
confirm.reversed: Sale reversed. It no longer counts in your sales.
confirm.correctBody: It is reversed and a copy opens as a new draft. Fix the copy ({{names}}) and finalize it.
confirm.correctSheetBody: These sales are reversed and a copy opens as your sheet for the same days. Fix it and finalize it.
confirm.correctNote: Until the copy is finalized, these sales don't count.
confirm.corrected: Sale reversed. Here is the copy to fix.
confirm.discardBody: It's deleted. Nothing else changes: a draft never counted in your sales.
confirm.fillBody: What you paid the driver or the courier for this delivery.
confirm.fillNote: It is entered once and then stays as it is.

import.title: Import sales from a file
import.intro: Bring in the sales your POS, delivery app or online store exported. The file is read on this device and never uploaded.
import.notOpen: Importing sales needs the permission to import sales from a file. Ask the owner.

templates.intro: No file from your system? Download a template, fill it in, then import it.

import.pickHint: Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV. You can also drop it here.
import.privacy: The file stays on this device. Only the totals of each day and item are sent: customer names and phones never leave it.
import.channelHint: All the sales in this file are for this channel.

readErrors.too_large: This file is too large. Import up to 25 MB at a time (one month, or one branch).
readErrors.unreadable: This file can't be read. Save it again as .xlsx or .csv, then try again.
readErrors.not_supported: Choose an Excel file (.xlsx or .xls) or a CSV file.

import.alreadyImported: This file was already imported on {{date}}. To import it again, reverse that import first.
import.alreadyImportedDraft: This file is already being imported: a draft from {{date}}. Continue it, or delete it to import the file again.
import.alreadyImportedHidden: This file is already in an import from {{date}} that you can't open. Ask the owner about it.

columns.intro: We matched the columns by their names. Check each one, and change any that is wrong.
columns.savedFound: You imported a file with these same columns before.
columns.savedUsed: Using the columns you chose last time.
columns.useSaved: Use the columns from last time

fields.name: Item name
fields.qtyHint: Without it, each row counts as 1.
fields.dateHint: Without it, you say which days the file covers.
fields.codeHint: Shops match their items by code.
fields.taxHint: Taken off the amount, so the sales are before VAT.
fields.feeHint: Its total becomes this channel's statement for the file's days.
fields.orderHint: An order's later rows take its first row's day.

mappingErrors.name_missing: Choose the column with the item names.
mappingErrors.amount_missing: Choose the column with the amounts.
mappingErrors.column_twice: One column is chosen twice. Each column goes with one thing only.

period.intro: This file has no day column, so say which days its sales are for.
period.rangeHint: Within one month. They are saved as one sale on the last day.
period.onLastDay: Saved as one sale on {{date}}, covering these days.

errors.order: The first day must come before the last.
errors.future: Choose today or an earlier day.

vat.yesHint: For example, a latte at {{gross}} with VAT is {{net}} before VAT.
vat.noHint: VAT is added on top of them.

problems.name_missing: Choose the column with the item names.
problems.amount_missing: Choose the column with the amounts.
problems.no_rows: No sales were found in this file with these columns. Check the columns and the row of names.
problems.period_missing: Say which days these sales are for.
problems.period_over_month: This file covers more than one month. Import one month at a time.
problems.vat_answer_missing: Say whether these amounts include VAT.

summary.title: What we read
summary.totalRows_one: {{count}} total row was skipped, so nothing counts twice.
summary.totalRows_other: {{count}} total rows were skipped, so nothing counts twice.

names.intro: Each name in the file must be one of your products, or not something you sell. Your answers are remembered for the next files.
names.fileAmounts: Amounts here are as the file gives them, with VAT.
names.addAllLeft: Names that look like one of your products, or like tips, a service charge or delivery, are left for you to settle: {{number}}.

treatmentHints.skip: Left out of your sales: tips, a discount line, something you don't sell.
treatmentHints.charge: Counts as sales, with no cost.
treatmentHints.delivery: Counts in what deliveries earn or cost you.

days.otherSales: Sales were also entered for this day in Today's sales or One sale. If they are the same sales as in this file, they count twice: reverse them first, or take this day out of the file.

preview.intro: Check what will be finalized. Nothing counts until you finalize.
preview.afterNames: Shown once every name is settled
preview.costsNote: What each item cost is worked out from the purchases entered so far.
preview.unpriced: No price yet: {{names}}. Their cost is added when you enter their purchases.

overlap.legend_one: {{count}} day is already imported from another file
overlap.legend_other: {{count}} days are already imported from another file
overlap.replaceHint: Their earlier sales are reversed, and this file counts instead.
overlap.replaceLocked: Replacing days reverses finalized sales, so it needs the permission to reverse sales. Ask the owner.

import.rowsMissing: Not all rows of this file arrived. Discard it and import the file again.
import.conflict: This import was changed somewhere else. Check it again, then finalize.

confirm.title: Finalize these sales?
confirm.bodyPeriod: This adds {{channel}}'s sales of {{from}} – {{to}}, saved as one sale on {{date}}: {{amount}}.
confirm.note: Each day's cost is worked out on that day. To take them back later, reverse a day or the whole file.
confirm.replaceNote_one: {{count}} day already imported is replaced: its earlier sales are reversed.
confirm.replaceNote_other: {{count}} days already imported are replaced: their earlier sales are reversed.
confirm.otherSalesNote: Some of these days also have sales entered in Today's sales or One sale. If they are the same sales as in the file, they count twice.
confirm.discardBody: The rows sent from this file are removed. Your answers for its names are kept.
confirm.addAllTitle: Add these names as new products?
confirm.addAllBody: Each becomes a product sold by the piece, at its average price in the file.
confirm.addAllNote: They stay in your products even if you delete this import.
confirm.reverseBody: Every sale imported from {{file}} is reversed, as if it was never finalized.
confirm.reverseDayBody: The sales of {{date}} from this file are reversed, as if never finalized.
confirm.reverseNote: A day in closed books is taken back on the first open day. The file can then be imported again.

import.reversedNote: This import is reversed: its sales no longer count. You can import its file again.
import.replacedNote: It replaced earlier imported sales of: {{days}}.
import.notFoundBody: It may have been discarded, or it is not open to you.

list.title: Imported files
list.emptyBody: Import the sales your POS, delivery app or online store exported, one file at a time.
